analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 45.6 to 63.0 over 5 days, exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -0.2929 to 0.3703, indicating sustained upward momentum. ADX at 14.9 indicates a lack of trend formation, suggesting potential for shock-like volatility.
